title: The Robot Who Learned to Help
summary: A household helper robot keeps making small mistakes while trying to be useful, until his family patiently teaches him, and he finally helps in just the right way during a busy morning.
poll: A robot that keeps making mistakes should be sent back instead of given more chances.

versions.title: The Robot Who Learned to Help
versions.text:
Lina has a new robot. His name is Robi. Robi wants to help. He wants to do chores.

One day, Robi waters a plant. He pours too much water. It is a mistake! The pot is full of water.

Mom is not mad. She shows Robi a better way. She uses a small cup.

Robi tries to vacuum next. He makes one more mistake. He picks up a toy car!

Dad is not mad too. He shows Robi how to look first. Robi tries again. He tries and he tries.

One day, the house is busy. The family is late. Lina can not find her shoes. Omar can not find his bag. The toast burns.

Robi helps! He waters the plant just right. He finds the shoes. He finds the bag. He makes new toast.

Everyone is glad. Robi helped the right way.

versions.title: The Robot Who Learned to Help
versions.text:
Lina's family gets a new helper robot named Robi. Everyone is curious how he will fit in. From day one, Robi wants to help with every chore he can find.

One afternoon, Robi tries to water the plants by himself. He has not learned the right setting yet. He pours far too much water into each pot. The soil gets soaked, and water spills onto the floor.

Mom does not get upset. She kneels beside Robi and patiently shows him the right way. She measures a small cup of water so he can see how much a plant really needs.

The next day, Robi tries vacuuming on his own. His sensors are not set correctly yet. He nearly sucks up Omar's toy car from under the couch.

Dad is just as patient as Mom. He calmly shows Robi how to check the floor and adjust his vacuum setting first. Robi tries again and again, getting a little better each time.

One busy morning, the family grows frantic because everyone is running late. Lina cannot find her shoes, Omar cannot find his bag, and the toast turns black in the toaster.

This time, Robi finally helps in just the right way. He waters the plant with the correct setting, finds the shoes and the bag, and makes a fresh batch of toast.

The grateful family thanks Robi warmly. After many small mistakes, he has finally learned how to help the right way, at the right time.

versions.title: The Robot Who Learned to Help
versions.text:
Lina's family welcomes a brand new helper robot into their home, and everyone is genuinely curious to see exactly how he will fit into their busy daily routine. His name is Robi, and from his very first day in the house, he seems endlessly eager to help with every chore he can possibly find.

One quiet afternoon, Robi decides it is finally time to water the household plants entirely on his own, without asking anyone for guidance. Because he has not yet learned the correct setting for each pot, he pours far too much water into every single one. The soil becomes thoroughly soaked, and water quickly spills across the kitchen floor.

Mom is not upset in the least. Instead, she kneels down beside Robi and patiently shows him the proper way to do it, carefully measuring out a small cup of water so he can see for himself exactly how much a plant actually needs to thrive.

The next day, Robi decides to try vacuuming the entire living room entirely on his own, hoping to finish the job before anyone even notices. Because his sensors are not yet adjusted correctly, he makes another small mistake, nearly sucking up Omar's little toy car from underneath the couch.

Dad remains just as patient as Mom had been earlier that week. He calmly shows Robi how to check the floor carefully and adjust his vacuum setting before switching the machine on. Robi tries again and again, improving noticeably with each new attempt he makes.

One especially busy morning, the whole family grows frantic because everyone is running quite late for school and work. Lina cannot find her shoes anywhere, Omar cannot find his school bag, and the toast turns black and burnt inside the toaster.

This time, Robi finally manages to help in exactly the right way, without making a single mistake. He waters the plant using the correct setting, finds the shoes tucked under the couch, locates the missing bag resting by the door, and prepares a fresh batch of toast just in time.

The grateful family thanks Robi warmly for all his help. After many small mistakes along the way, Robi has finally learned how to help in just the right way, at exactly the right moment.

versions.text:

One quiet afternoon, Robi decided it was finally time to water the household plants entirely on his own, without asking anyone for guidance beforehand. Because he had not yet calibrated the correct setting for each pot, he poured far too much water into every single one. The soil became thoroughly soaked, and water quickly spilled across the kitchen floor, overwhelming the little drainage trays beneath each pot.

Mom was not upset in the least. Instead, she knelt down beside Robi and patiently showed him the proper way to do it, meticulously measuring out a small cup of water so he could see for himself exactly how much a plant actually needs to thrive.

The next day, Robi decided to try vacuuming the entire living room entirely on his own, hoping to finish the job before anyone even noticed. Because his sensors were not yet adjusted correctly, he made another small mistake, nearly sucking up Omar's little toy car from underneath the couch.

Dad remained just as patient as Mom had been earlier that week. He calmly showed Robi how to check the floor carefully and calibrate his vacuum setting before switching the machine on, and Robi tried again and again, improving noticeably with each diligent attempt.

One especially busy morning, the whole family grew frantic because everyone was running quite late for school and work. Lina could not find her shoes anywhere, Omar could not find his school bag, and the toast turned black and burnt inside the toaster, filling the kitchen with smoke.

This time, feeling anything but overwhelmed, Robi finally managed to help in exactly the right way, without making a single mistake. He watered the plant using the correct setting, found the shoes tucked under the couch, located the missing bag resting by the door, and prepared a fresh batch of toast just in time.

The family, filled with gratitude, thanked Robi warmly for all of his diligent help. After many small mistakes along the way, Robi had finally learned how to help in just the right way, at exactly the right moment.

versions.title: The Robot Who Learned to Help: Just the Right Way
versions.text:
Lina's family welcomed a newly purchased helper robot into their home, and everyone was curious to discover how such a device would fit into their busy daily routine, with its predictable rhythms and its stubbornly unpredictable mornings existing side by side. His name was Robi, and from his first day in the household, he appeared endlessly eager to assist with every chore, although his enthusiasm did not always match his actual competence.

One quiet afternoon, Robi decided it was finally the moment to water the household plants without supervision, neglecting to request guidance beforehand. Because he had not yet calibrated the correct setting for each pot, he poured far too much water into every container. The soil became thoroughly saturated, and water spilled across the kitchen floor, overwhelming the small drainage trays beneath each pot.

Mom remained entirely unperturbed. She knelt down beside Robi and patiently demonstrated the proper technique, meticulously measuring out a modest cup of water so that he could observe exactly how much a plant genuinely requires to flourish without drowning.

The following day, Robi resolved to attempt vacuuming the living room without supervision, hoping to finish before anyone noticed what he was attempting. Because his sensors had not yet been calibrated correctly, he committed another small blunder, narrowly avoiding ingesting Omar's toy car from beneath the couch.

Dad proved himself every bit as patient as Mom had been earlier that week. He calmly showed Robi how to inspect the floor and calibrate his vacuum's setting before activating the machine, and Robi persisted repeatedly, improving noticeably with each diligent attempt.

On one especially chaotic morning, the household grew increasingly frantic because every member was running quite late for school and work simultaneously. Lina could not locate her shoes anywhere, Omar could not locate his school bag, and the toast became thoroughly blackened inside the toaster, filling the kitchen with smoke.

On this occasion, feeling anything but overwhelmed despite the chaos, Robi finally succeeded in helping in exactly the right manner, without committing a single error. He watered the plant using the correct setting, discovered the shoes tucked beneath the couch, located the missing bag resting beside the door, and prepared a fresh batch of toast just in time for everyone to eat before rushing out the door.

The household, filled with quiet gratitude, thanked Robi warmly for his diligent assistance. After numerous small mistakes along the way, Robi had ultimately learned exactly how to help in the right manner, at the right moment, without ever once being asked to do so.

versions.title: The Robot Who Learned to Help: Just the Right Way
versions.text:
Lina's family welcomed a newly purchased helper robot into their household, and everyone remained genuinely curious to discover precisely how such a device would ultimately integrate into their busy daily routine, with its predictable rhythms and its stubbornly unpredictable mornings persistently coexisting. His designation was Robi, and from his very first day inhabiting the household, he appeared endlessly eager to assist with every conceivable chore imaginable, although his boundless enthusiasm did not consistently correspond to his actual, demonstrated competence at executing it properly.

One ordinarily tranquil afternoon, Robi determined that it was finally the appropriate moment to irrigate the household plants entirely without supervision, neglecting entirely to request guidance from anyone beforehand. Because he had not yet properly calibrated the correct setting corresponding to each individual pot, he dispensed far too much water into every single container. The surrounding soil became thoroughly saturated, and overflow water rapidly spilled across the kitchen floor, overwhelming the modest drainage trays carefully positioned beneath each pot.

Mom remained entirely unperturbed throughout this particular ordeal. Instead, she knelt down beside Robi and patiently demonstrated the appropriate technique, meticulously measuring out a modest cup of water so that he could personally observe exactly how much hydration a plant genuinely requires in order to flourish without being inadvertently drowned.

The following day, Robi resolved to attempt vacuuming the entire living room without any form of supervision whatsoever, hoping privately to complete the undertaking before anyone else even noticed what he was quietly attempting to accomplish. Because his internal sensors had not yet been calibrated correctly, he committed another minor blunder, narrowly avoiding ingesting Omar's small toy car from beneath the couch.

Dad proved himself every bit as patient as Mom had demonstrated earlier that very week. He calmly illustrated for Robi how to inspect the floor meticulously and calibrate his vacuum's setting prior to activating the machine, and Robi persisted repeatedly, improving noticeably with each diligent, conscientious attempt he patiently undertook.

On one especially chaotic morning, the entire household grew increasingly frantic because every single member was running considerably late for both school and work simultaneously, with precious minutes steadily disappearing. Lina could not locate her shoes anywhere, Omar could not locate his school bag, and the toast became thoroughly blackened and burnt inside the toaster, filling the kitchen with acrid smoke.

On this particular occasion, feeling anything but overwhelmed despite the surrounding chaos, Robi finally succeeded in assisting in precisely the correct manner, without committing a single error of any description whatsoever. He irrigated the plant using the properly calibrated setting, discovered the shoes tucked beneath the couch, located the missing bag resting beside the door, and prepared an entirely fresh batch of toast just in time for everyone to consume before rushing out the door together.

The household, suffused with quiet gratitude, thanked Robi warmly for all of his diligent, conscientious assistance. After numerous minor mistakes accumulated along the way, Robi had ultimately learned precisely how to help in exactly the right manner, at exactly the appropriate moment, without ever once being explicitly requested to do so.

keyWords.definition: a machine that can move and do jobs, sometimes on its own
keyWords.example: The robot picked up the blocks and put them in the box.

keyWords.definition: something done the wrong way by accident
keyWords.example: I made a mistake and put sugar in my tea instead of salt.

keyWords.definition: to clean a floor by sucking up dirt and dust with a machine
keyWords.example: Dad likes to vacuum the carpet every Saturday.

keyWords.definition: a small job you do regularly at home
keyWords.example: Taking out the trash is my favorite chore.

keyWords.definition: having a lot to do in a short amount of time
keyWords.example: The kitchen was busy as everyone cooked breakfast together.

questions.stem: What is this story mostly about?
options: A boy who loses his toy car at school and looks for it
A robot who makes mistakes but learns to help right
A family that plants a new garden outside
A family that buys a new car for their house
questions.why: The whole story follows Robi as he makes mistakes and slowly learns to help the family in the right way.

wrong.A: Omar's toy car is found at home, not lost at school.
wrong.C: The story is about watering plants indoors, not planting a garden.
wrong.D: The story is about a robot, not a car.

questions.stem: What mistake does Robi make when he waters the plants?
options: He forgets to water them at all
He waters the wrong plants
He pours too much water into the pots
He waters the plants outside instead
questions.why: The story says Robi pours too much water into the pots, and water spills onto the floor.

wrong.A: Robi does water the plants; he just uses too much water.
wrong.B: The story does not say he waters the wrong plants.
wrong.D: The plants are inside the house, not outside.

questions.stem: What does Robi almost vacuum up by mistake?
options: Omar's toy car
Mom's shoes
a book from the shelf
a kitchen towel
questions.why: The story says Robi picks up Omar's toy car by mistake while vacuuming.

wrong.B: The story does not mention shoes being vacuumed.
wrong.C: The story does not mention a book.
wrong.D: The story does not mention a towel.

questions.stem: In the story, a chore is —
options: a loud sound made by a vacuum
a small job done at home
a type of plant
a kind of helpful household robot
questions.why: The story uses chores to mean the small jobs Robi wants to help with around the house, like watering plants and vacuuming.

wrong.A: A chore is not a sound.
wrong.C: A chore is not a type of plant.
wrong.D: A chore is a job, not a robot.

questions.stem: Why are Mom and Dad not upset when Robi makes mistakes?
options: They plan to return Robi to the store
They think the mistakes are funny jokes
They do not notice the mistakes
They want Robi to learn slowly and patiently
questions.why: Mom and Dad calmly show Robi the right way each time, which shows they want him to learn, not give up on him.

wrong.A: The story never says they want to return Robi.
wrong.B: The story never says they laugh at the mistakes as jokes.
wrong.C: They clearly notice the water on the floor and the toy car.

questions.stem: Why does the family feel so rushed on the busy morning?
options: Robi is too slow to get ready for school
Everyone is running late and things go wrong
The family is moving to a new house this morning
The toaster breaks and cannot be fixed by anyone
questions.why: The family is late, and problems like lost shoes and burnt toast make the morning feel very busy and stressful.

wrong.A: The story is not about Robi being slow.
wrong.C: The story does not mention moving.
wrong.D: The toaster works again later to make fresh toast.

questions.stem: What happens right after Robi makes the mistake with the plants?
options: Dad buys a brand new robot
Robi tries to vacuum the next day
The family goes on a camping trip
Robi finds Lina's shoes
questions.why: The story says that the next day after the watering mistake, Robi tries to vacuum and makes another mistake.

wrong.A: The family keeps the same robot the whole story.
wrong.C: The story never mentions a camping trip.
wrong.D: Finding the shoes happens much later, on the busy morning.

questions.stem: What does Robi do differently on the busy morning compared to his first tries?
options: He waters the plants one more time only, and then he rests
He helps in just the right way with no mistakes
He makes the same mistakes again and again all morning
He refuses to help at all that day and sits in a corner
questions.why: Unlike his earlier tries, Robi waters the plant correctly, finds the shoes and bag, and makes toast with no mistakes.

wrong.A: Robi does much more than just water the plants that morning.
wrong.C: Robi does not repeat his old mistakes.
wrong.D: Robi helps a great deal that morning, not refuses.

LOW.prompt: Imagine your family had a helper robot like Robi. Write about one chore you would want it to help with and how you would patiently teach it to do the chore the right way.
checklist: I named one chore the robot would help with.
I explained how I would patiently teach it.
I wrote complete sentences with capital letters and periods.
LOW.modelAnswer: If my family had a robot like Robi, I would want it to help set the table. At first, it might put forks in the wrong place. I would patiently show it where each plate, fork, and cup should go. I would let it try again and again until it learned. Just like Robi, it would finally help in just the right way.

keyWords.definition: able to stay calm and wait without getting annoyed, even when something is slow or difficult
keyWords.example: The coach was patient while the young players learned the new game.

keyWords.definition: very wet, as if completely filled with water
keyWords.example: Her socks were soaked after she stepped in the puddle.

keyWords.definition: the way a machine is adjusted to work in a certain way
keyWords.example: She changed the setting on the fan to make it spin faster.

keyWords.definition: feeling or acting very rushed and worried
keyWords.example: The frantic shopper searched everywhere for her missing keys.

keyWords.definition: feeling thankful for something someone has done
keyWords.example: He was grateful when his friend helped him carry the heavy boxes.

questions.stem: Which sentence best tells what this story is mainly about?
options: A robot slowly learns, through patient teaching, how to help a family in exactly the right way
A family decides that robots are too much trouble to keep in their home, so they sell it
A boy loses his toy car and never manages to find it again, however hard he looks
A family grows new plants in their garden every single season, and the plants win a prize
questions.why: The story follows Robi through his early mistakes until patient teaching helps him finally help in just the right way.

wrong.B: The family keeps Robi and is happy with him by the end.
wrong.C: The toy car is briefly almost vacuumed, not permanently lost.
wrong.D: The story is about one set of indoor plants, not a garden across seasons.

questions.stem: What happens to the soil in the pots after Robi's first attempt at watering?
options: It dries out completely
It turns a different color

MID.prompt: Explain how patient teaching from Mom and Dad helped Robi go from making mistakes to helping in just the right way. Use at least two details from the story.
checklist: I explained how Mom and Dad taught Robi patiently.
I explained how Robi's helping changed over time.
I used at least two details from the story.
MID.modelAnswer: At first, Robi made mistakes because he had not learned the right settings yet, like pouring too much water on the plants and almost vacuuming up Omar's toy car. Instead of getting upset, Mom and Dad patiently showed him the correct way to do each chore, measuring water and checking the floor together. Because they kept teaching him calmly, Robi finally understood how each chore should be done. On the busy, frantic morning, he used what he had learned to water the plant correctly, find the shoes and bag, and make fresh toast, helping the grateful family in just the right way.

HIGH.prompt: The story suggests that patient, meticulous teaching matters more than natural skill when learning something new. Do you agree or disagree? Support your answer with evidence from Robi's experience.
checklist: I supported my position with specific evidence from the story.
I addressed a point someone might make against my view.
HIGH.modelAnswer: I agree that patient, meticulous teaching matters more than natural skill when learning something new. Robi was not naturally skilled at his chores; his settings were not calibrated, and his early attempts led to soaked soil and a nearly vacuumed toy car. What changed his performance was not some sudden burst of natural ability, but Mom and Dad's diligent, patient demonstrations of the correct way to do each task. By the frantic morning, Robi applied those lessons calmly instead of feeling overwhelmed, which shows that steady teaching built his competence. Someone might argue that Robi's own effort and willingness to keep trying mattered just as much, and that is fair, but without the family's patient guidance, his enthusiasm alone would likely have led to the same mistakes again and again.
